_comment_Groq: Do NOT hardcode the key here. Set it via user-secrets: dotnet user-secrets set "Groq:ApiKey" "<key>" (or the Groq__ApiKey env var). Empty ApiKey disables the Groq grader.
_comment_GroqModel: Groq retires models on a published schedule (console.groq.com/docs/deprecations) — llama-3.3-70b-versatile was decommissioned 2026-08-16. Model is configurable so the next migration is a config change. ReasoningEffort (low|medium|high) applies to reasoning models such as gpt-oss; set it to "" for a non-reasoning model so the reasoning parameters are dropped from the request.
_comment_FrontendRunner: Auto-grades Frontend Project questions by running the candidate's app against the author's hidden tests in a sandboxed Docker container. Disabled by default (Frontend Project questions then go to human review). To enable: build the images in docker/frontend-runner/, set Enabled=true, and map each framework to its image tag.
